role: CI gate: every CoreMotion handler closure passed to start*/query* APIs must be queue-delivered (`to:` on queue APIs) or start with `@Sendable`, preventing main-actor isolation SIGTRAPs on CoreMotion threads.
toplevel: cd to repo root. Roots = args or Emuqu and 'EmuquWatch Watch App'; exit 2 if no Swift file found. Python strips // comments (string-aware), finds `.startRelativeAltitudeUpdates(` etc. and `.startUpdates(`/`.queryPedometerData(`; looks in a 400-char window for the first `{`; no `{` -> skipped; queue APIs with `to:` -> ok; body starting `@Sendable` -> ok; else violation (exit 1). Wired: gates.yml 'Source hygiene guards' (make coremotion-isolation-guard, push and pull_request), ci.yml and Makefile.
